description: REMOVE THE SLICE CAVE COMPLETELY. Restores the spin-builder hook to its original instruction and blanks both cave regions back to int3 padding. Reason: with the cave live, passes flew off in the wrong direction at the wrong speed — a signature of ball-state corruption, not spin. The cave's target register was mis-identified twice (the disassembly-derived axis basis did not match in-game behaviour), so it is being removed pending an empirical axis identification rather than another inferred guess. Leaves all value-based patches (error model, fouls, AI, ratings) intact.
